scope: Complete author reading of both conceptual pages, with source inspection of REST create/update handlers and comparison to the transaction reference. This is a semantic and readability review, not final candidate execution.

reviews.reason: Identity, persistence and execution paths progress from ordinary requests to delayed work. Explicit transaction guidance avoids implying request-wide atomicity; application-owned policy and external effects remain bounded.
Defines five stability labels, links authoritative version contracts, and distinguishes planner and DurableStep behavior from stable execution guarantees.
